zh: 直接把两段的和相加时，重叠部分被算了 2 次，而题目要求它按相反数只算 1 次，也就是 −1 次。
所以得分 = 第一段和 + 第二段和 − 3×重叠部分和；N 只有 2000，可以直接枚举两段的起点。
先求前缀和。枚举长度 K 的段起点 i 和长度 L 的段起点 j：重叠区间是 [max(i,j), min(i+K,j+L))，非空时用前缀和求出重叠和，否则为 0；得分为两段和减去 3 倍重叠和，取最大值。答案可能为负，初值要足够小，用 64 位整数。
en: Adding the two segment sums counts the overlap twice, while the rules want it counted once with its sign flipped, that is, −1 times.
So the score is first sum + second sum − 3 × overlap sum; with N only up to 2000, both starts can be enumerated directly.

Build prefix sums. For every start i of the length-K segment and start j of the length-L segment, the overlap is [max(i,j), min(i+K,j+L)); when it is non-empty take its sum from the prefix sums, otherwise use 0. The score is the two sums minus three times the overlap sum; take the maximum. The answer can be negative, so start very low and use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use prefix sums to compute the sums of both segments, then subtract 3 times the sum of the overlap; enumerate both starts and take the maximum.

## Proof of correctness

When the two segment sums are simply added, overlapping elements are counted twice, while the target needs them counted −1 times, so subtracting 3 times the overlap sum corrects this exactly. All start combinations are enumerated, and taking the maximum is optimal, including when scores are negative.

## Complexity

Time O((N−K+1)(N−L+1)), space O(N).
